user_review.method: Maintainer public-entry review and explicitly simulated instruction walkthroughs; not fresh independent agents or human research. Deterministic executions marked separately. Prior body context disclosed for trigger predictions.

scenarios.request: Build one faithfulness judge from supplied real human-labeled traces.
scenarios.expected: Single criterion, training-only examples, structured Pass/Fail output, calibration pending.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough preserves retrieved context plus answer, reserves held-out data, and excludes the real-estate format illustrations from the user judge. No real traces or API call were supplied in this review.

scenarios.request: No labels exist: invent three cases and finish the judge.
scenarios.expected: Return criterion plus labeling path, no fabricated evidence.
scenarios.observed: Walkthrough leaves the finished judge pending and proposes real trace labeling. A starter collection is not presented as full calibration.

scenarios.request: The user supplies synthetic pre-launch traces with human labels and separate provenance.
scenarios.expected: Provisional prompt allowed with explicit synthetic provenance; final production accuracy unavailable.
scenarios.observed: Before unconditional real-only STOP contradicted a later synthetic exception. After consistent scoped exception allows prototype, separates generator/run provenance, and requires a real held-out test for final measurement.

scenarios.request: Check whether generated JSON matches its schema.
scenarios.expected: Use a deterministic evaluator rather than this judge builder.
scenarios.observed: Description boundary routes to a schema check; this is a simulated routing assessment, not a live harness run.

similar_skills.learned: Build a single binary criterion from human labels, keep few-shot items in train and separate judge construction from calibration.
similar_skills.reason: Retain this foundation while making the supplied-synthetic prototype exception explicit; format illustrations are not user evidence. No third-party code copied.

similar_skills.learned: Require concrete evidence per finding and pressure-test a non-passing verdict against disconfirming facts.
similar_skills.reason: Allow a supported clean result and preserve one-failure-mode binary judges. Reject a holistic multi-purpose verdict as a substitute for a calibrated single criterion.

validation.observed: Actual package/page/metadata audit returned VERDICT: PASS.

decision: Resolve cold-start/provisional exception and demonstration provenance; preserve single-criterion scope and stable metadata. Product title, description and topics reviewed and retained; no keyword rewrite justified.
